mentions.name: Itse
mentions.description: A system of fabric construction blocks — like Lego for clothing — that lets people assemble clothing and accessories completely by hand, without any tools or machines. Prototypes have been worn and washed for years, and the system has also been applied to footwear with soft rubber or cut Vibram soles.
